On the left, the boy with shaggy dark hair (R2) in a white t-shirt and brown pants leans forward. In the center, the girl with braided hair (R1) in an orange t-shirt and yellow cropped pants holds a green rope. In the right foreground, the girl with pigtails (R3) in a white floral-embroidered top and yellow floral shorts pulls the rope forward. The three children are lined up playing tug-of-war under bright, soft indoor lighting.
